about_the_game:
Deep in an ever advancing computer, forgotten and unchanged, remains chess program Ver. 1. Peace is shattered by a software update! Can you stop the invading bytes before being overwritten?

  • Hark at the minimal bauhaus graphics.

  • Absorb the drone soundtrack.

  • Relax in the warm hum of an old chess computer.

Use a mouse, touchscreen, controller or keyboard to control the game.

Keyboard: WASD or Arrows to move, ENTER to select, DEL to open inventory

Controller: Left stick to move, A to select, B to open inventory.

  • OS: macOS 10.12 (Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or Apple Silicon (M1/M2)

short_description: Questy Chess is a puzzling RPG set in the world of an ageing chess computer. Make your way though 1 demo world, using your inventory of powers and moves, to restore peace to this humble chess program. Supports replaying each level to improve on your previous score.
